visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Concert footage opens the scene, depicting approximately nine performers in white fringed stage outfits and matching white knee-high boots. They are positioned on a wide, dark stage floor illuminated by intense blue and violet spotlights. The background is filled with blurred points of light from an audience. (2) A young woman with long dark hair and a white off-the-shoulder top is shown in a bright indoor studio. Her facial expressions are animated with a clear focus on the camera lens. She uses diverse hand gestures, pointing to the side where a graphic of a celebrity ambassador appears intermittently. (3) A close-up shot transitions to the woman holding a frosted glass bottle with a red logo and silver cap. She displays the product prominently against her white garment, tilting it to show the clear liquid within. The lighting is soft, even, and professional, minimizing shadows. (4) The visuals shift back to stage footage, featuring a single performer dancing in a brown and khaki outfit under hazy, warm yellow stage lights. The camera captures her full body and the surrounding atmosphere of a crowded performance venue filled with digital devices held aloft by spectators. (5) In the indoor setting, the camera zooms into the woman's hands as she pours clear liquid from the bottle into her palm. She then uses both hands to pat her cheeks and chin. Her skin appears dewy and reflective under the studio lights. (6) A sequence of outdoor clips shows the woman in natural daylight, looking directly at the lens. Her skin is shown in close-up, appearing smooth and glowing. She touches her face with a finger to highlight specific areas. Passers-by and urban structures are visible in the soft-focus background. (7) Returning to the indoor studio, the woman holds the product bottle and a red bear-shaped keychain. Complex text overlays in Traditional Chinese appear across the lower third of the frame. She finishes by placing the bottle and keychain into a beige handbag and closing the zipper.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with upbeat, high-tempo synth-pop music featuring a strong electronic drum beat. A female narrator speaks with an energetic, bright, and enthusiastic tone, maintaining a fast speech rate. The recording quality is high, with a clean studio silence background. (2) A sharp, bright 'pop' sound effect is heard as variety text appears on the screen. The music continues without interruption, providing a consistent rhythmic base. The narrator's voice is well-articulated and dominant in the mix, with frequent rising intonations indicating excitement. (3) The acoustic texture shifts to include delicate foley sounds, specifically the splashing and trickling of liquid being poured, followed by a rhythmic series of soft, percussive thudding sounds representing patting on skin. The music volume ducks slightly to emphasize these textures. (4) The narrator transitions to an informative tone for a promotional announcement, with her voice becoming more authoritative. A clear metallic zipper sound marks a scene transition. The background music maintains its intensity until the final seconds, where it reaches a melodic peak and cuts cleanly.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Context -> Personal Experience -> Reward -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional tie-in for SK-II skincare products, specifically the Facial Treatment Essence. It leverages the hype of the K-pop group TWICE's concert in Kaohsiung and member Mina's role as a brand ambassador to target fans (ONCEs). The creator shares her personal skincare ritual to achieve 'concert-ready' skin, ending with a call-to-action regarding a promotional giveaway for signed merchandise.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the SK-II bottle, mention of the brand name and brand ambassador Mina, and detailed promotional giveaway information.
